💪 Train. Transform. Become Unstoppable.

Find codes in the social links below!

Start as a beginner and train your way to ultimate strength! Unlock powerful characters, grow your muscles, and dominate each world as you become stronger than ever before.

🔥 FEATURES

🏋️ Train at machines to increase your strength
💥 Watch your muscles grow in real time
👤 Unlock and max out powerful new characters
🐾 Collect pets to boost your training speed
🌎 Explore new worlds with stronger challenges
⭐ Rebirth by completing characters and progress further

Each character is stronger than the last. Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

🚧 More worlds and characters coming soon!

👍 Like the game for more updates
🔔 Follow to stay notified when new content releases
